environment: Canonical Vercel Production, real Neon reviewed synthetic pilot workspace
scope: Read-only browser rendering, approved source viewing and export verification; session sign-in and missing-invite refusal checks only.
testType: Real Chromium browser and HTTPS/API integration; no mocks

checks.name: Arabic mobile login: invite-only message, code field before enabled role buttons, localized missing-code refusal, no overflow
English/LTR login and localized missing-code refusal; prior-language error clears on switch
All published concepts render without the former twelve-node cap
L1–L6 filters show every matching concept and select a matching detail
Arabic and English search select a concept with working exact lecture and Umbrella locators
Accessible table contains the complete published concept map
English/LTR retains the selected concept and map state
Arabic mobile map renders at 390px without horizontal viewport overflow
Filtered UI exports the entire approved map as JSON, CSV and bilingual HTML with absolute source URLs and no private source text/keys

visualReview.layout: Code field appears before the role buttons. Arabic RTL and English LTR remain readable. No horizontal viewport overflow at 390px mobile or 1305px desktop.
visualReview.nonBlockingObservation: The reference font renders the external-link arrow on source locator links as a small fallback glyph; source labels, page/section locators and links remain functional.

privacy: This summary excludes access codes, session cookies, private source passages and local credential/artifact paths. Screenshots and full browser artifacts remain private.
limits: Browser source-opening checks sample one approved lecture page and one Umbrella section; they do not open every locator individually.
This browser run made no Gemini calls and does not substitute for the separate real-provider API acceptance run.
